violated_contract: A phone-durable, indexed ring download must retain its exact ring and sequence proof across BLE session replacement, pass cancellation and process restart. A transient live-session epoch must not own durable download evidence; elapsed total time must not abandon an active read or permit overlapping reads.
canonical_prevention: Commit immutable ring coordinates and file length in the WAL index transaction; retain exact-range receipts independently of live epochs; validate persisted index, file bytes, owner and contiguous coverage before each ADVANCE; replay before choosing READ start; retire acknowledged refs from repeated validation work; preserve one read owner until STOP, queued work and final durable tail settle; keep DATA-silence deadlines and renew ordinary coordinator lifetime only on actual DATA.
